data.content: Find the 10 most frequent multiple risk drivers

To make sure I pull the right ranking, could you clarify what you mean by “multiple risk drivers”? Do you want:

a) Top 10 substances that most frequently act as risk drivers across all site–time points

b) Top 10 co-occurring driver pairs (i.e., pairs of substances that are both drivers at the same site–time)

c) Top 10 substances most frequently involved in mixtures that had more than one driver (i.e., counting only site–time points with multiple drivers)

Once you choose, I’ll retrieve the results.
